runcō, runcāre

verb, first conjugation

weed out; clear of weeds

Other words

  • 1sāriō: long a, single r (Lewis & Short sarrio (sario), unmarked). De Vaan 539, s.v. sāriō: the form with a long vowel and one r is the older, sarriō the newer, as narrāre beside *gnārāre. Ruling: Which authority settles a vowel.

    sāriō1, sārīre — hoe, weed with a hoe

    verb, fourth conjugation · also used · classical · Cato Agr. 161.1 (Lewis & Short); Col. 11.2.10 (Lewis & Short)

    To work the soil round the plants with the sarculum and so kill the weeds; also written sarriō.

See also weed, hoe, tend the garden, dig.
